Name: Better Storm and Lightning - Totem
Author: rsjww
Description:
[size=3]It’s [b]highly recommended[/b] to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] for settings! Each option includes a detailed tooltip when you hover over it.

This mod adds two new craftable totems: [b]Lightning Totem[/b] and [b]Storm Totem[/b]. Use them to call down lightning or increase the chance of storms, just like the Rain Totem!

You can also adjust how lightning behaves during storms, or stay unchanged:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]Safe Lightning Mode[/b] – lightning absolutely won’t damage any terrain features (like crops and trees).[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Unsafe Lightning Mode[/b] – lightning strike terrain regardless of farmer's luck. By default, these events are rare.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=3]For extra fun, the mod lets you manually trigger lightning with configurable keys.

[b]!!! Compatibility note:[/b] Mods that alter lightning behavior (such as Safe Lightning or other all-lightning mods) conflict with this mod.
Multiplayer: Compatible, required to be installed by all players.

This is my first time creating a mod, so I’m still learning. I apologize for the frequent updates. Thank you for your support![/size]

Manifest.Name: Better Storm and Lightning
Manifest.Description: Add craftable Lightning Totem and Storm Totem to the game, along with options to control how lightning behaves during storms.
